Definitely recommend! This whole team is so excellent, and offer several flexible options. We love the booking app: it’s easy to use and booking requests are confirmed super quickly. Most importantly, walks are safe and secure and our pup LOVES going out for pack walks with his neighbourhood friends. We love that we get a little report with map and pics after every walk too!
Murphy received the best of care and we were very pleased with the reliable and friendly service that WalkDogs provided.

They are extremely reliable, trustworthy, and friendly with our dog Mia who can be difficult at times but the crew handles all without any issue. They proactively communicate everything you need to know. Couldn’t be happier with their service. Highly recommended!

Amazing team to work with. Samm truly works to ensure my pup has a great safe time (even when he's being a tough cookie). The entire team is diligent and caring and kind. A delight. Would highly recommend to anyone who wants their pups in the hands of caring walkers.

WalkDogs has been fabulous and helped me through a few emergencies where I was stuck for dog walking. They were flexible in scheduling and also understanding with pricing. Best of all, I have a highly reactive dog and they took so much time and effort to make my pup feel comfortable enough to walk with them. What started off as my dog barking, angry, and defensive of strangers in her home quickly turned into her jumping with excitement whenever they arrived! So thank you so much to WalkDogs for making my life so much easier in a crisis situation. I highly recommend them!
Sam and the whole WalkDogs crew are amazing with dogs! They are so reliable, professional, and treated our dog so well on all her walks.

Professional, reliable, affordable and has a great online portal for updates. You can see photos and even track your pup’s walk on a map - Strava for dog walking :) Samm is also so responsive and accommodating if there are any changes. Highly recommend!

We have had an incredible experience with the Walk Dogs team over the past year. They really took the time to get to know our pup and have tailored the walks to her. Our dog loves everyone on the team, and booking with Walk Dogs has been seamless. The whole team is fantastic - 10/10 recommend!

I have been using Walkdogs' services for over a year and a half and have had nothing but great experiences with them. I have a large reactive dog who requires special attention, and it is a relief to know that she is in experienced capable hands. They make sure she gets the exercise and enrichment she needs in a way that is safe for her, and everyone else. When I had a personal emergency and needed significantly more help, they were available for more frequent walks, and it was great to have that support during a difficult time. It is also clear that they genuinely enjoy and care about my dog, and the feeling is mutual (she loves her walkers, as do I!)
3 hours a week times 1 month equals 600.00.The cost is too high.

We are so happy with the service WalkDogs provides to our little guy. He loves his walker, Maria, and she takes great care of him. Booking on the app is also very helpful! But really the most important piece is I feel comfortable and trust they’ll take care of my best guy.
